about: MBTA transfer rules for tap-to-pay (contactless) and CharlieCard, by the route_fare_class in the MBTA's GTFS routes.txt. Single-ride prices are not here: they come from the MBTA's own fare tables through OpenTripPlanner, so they stay current. Checked against the MBTA's fare_transfer_rules.txt on 2026-10-16.
